summary: Master the art of infographics with our comprehensive training course. Transform complex data into engaging visuals and elevate your reporting skills.
lede: Infographics training teaches professionals to turn validated data into clear visual reports that support workplace decisions. It suits people who prepare, interpret, design, or approve reports, and covers data cleaning, chart selection, visual hierarchy, and accessible presentation. Learners apply these skills to create an infographic or dashboard, document data sources, and review the result for accessibility and trustworthiness.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who prepare, interpret, design, or approve visual reports and need a reliable foundation in infographics design and reporting. It supports foundation to intermediate learners and requires no programming experience.
prerequisites: No programming or coding experience is required. You should have basic workplace experience with spreadsheets, written reports, or presentation software. Familiarity with your organization's KPIs and reporting approval process will help you apply the exercises. The course teaches digital tools at operational application level, not technical engineering level.
